item.title: Kane Keid Unleashes a Sharp Freestyle on ‘Four Horsemen’
item.description: Kane Keid has released a freestyle over the instrumental of “Four Horsemen,” delivering his own lyrical interpretation of the widely discussed hip-hop record. The freestyle, now available on YouTube, sees the rapper step onto the beat used on the original track by Stogie T featuring Nasty C, A-Reece and Maggz. item.description: South African hip-hop rising star Nvcho is back with a bang!
